user.title: Connect to Pushover
user.description: Enter the application token and the user (or group) key for the Pushover account this integration should send as.

error.invalid_auth: The application token or user/group key was rejected by Pushover.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Pushover API.

abort.already_configured: This Pushover application/user combination is already configured.

defaults.title: Sending defaults
defaults.description: Used by notify.send_message and as fallbacks for pushover_advanced.send_message.

add_device.title: Add a device encryption key
add_device.description: Enter the device name exactly as registered with Pushover and the 64-character hex secret shown in the Pushover app once end-to-end encryption is enabled for that device.

error.invalid_key_format: That doesn't look like a valid 64-character hex AES secret.
error.retry_not_less_than_expire: Default retry must be less than default expire, otherwise emergency messages would never actually be retried.

abort.no_devices: No device encryption keys are configured yet.
